description: Analyze complete uploaded CSV/XLSX tables with DuckDB: exact money arithmetic, filters, joins, grouping and reconciliation. Prefer this for multi-row/table analysis instead of copying or summing rows mentally. Supply files with short SQL table names. Omit query first to inspect columns/types/preview. All input columns are VARCHAR: explicitly CAST money AS DECIMAL(18,2) and dates AS DATE. Then use one SELECT/WITH query, quoting column names when needed. No external reads/writes/network. Results cap200 rows, inputs50000 rows each; oversized inputs fail instead of silently computing partial totals. Reuse verified results when creating deliverables.
